# α3.13e — Follow the whole discovery

## What is new

History links real makers, teachers, learners and input items; Back restores your selection. Missing evidence says “no source recorded”. Public history keeps player attribution private. Portrait cards show action and reason; Details scrolls, large text and mute persist separately from camp saves. Tap/work/fire sounds follow actual actions and distance, with bounded voices.

Long seeks/recovery now discard unseen display trails. Food checks index carried items instead of scanning spent history inputs; seed 1001 stays exactly identical and runs about four times faster. No new e simulation records or save version: current format 5 refuses saves from earlier formats, without conversion.

## What to try

Start Discovery camp. Use 1 minute/sec to watch, pause to read, and 1 hour/sec to wait. Follow a discovered flake through History → maker/source/input → Back. Try Details with large text, then rotate to landscape. Inspect fire fuel and cooked food; send an idea from a handled memory, save/reopen, then read Your dreams and the actual later attempt. The labelled First flake example is for inspection, not discovery-frequency evidence.

[Check APK 41305](../build/apk-check/kindling-41305-check.apk). 29,286,411 bytes (27.930 MiB). Check packaging/verification: 333.39 s, 716.1 MiB peak. Final routine PASS: 931.49 s, 3.137 GiB peak (native view stress); 96 app and 165 tool tests passed. Single milestone audit PASS: 3,314.28 s, 3.133 GiB peak; TSan 301 cases/no reported race, twelve matching digest runs, 100 crash kills and scene/repeat checks passed. Retained M3 end digests also match Clang/GCC/ARM-NDK; emulation is not a phone measurement. One software-rendered self-review: 10:00–10:04 UTC. [Closing proof and principle report](M3-CHECKS.md).

## What is rough

Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase. Its check key cannot update the release-signed installation.

Full-kit closing gate: discovery **18/20 passes**, spread **6/20 fails**, two routes and zero-flake four-year control pass. Fresh idea pairs: **20/20 relevant tries passes**, eight successful sleepers/nine successes; all queued/delivered/final reopens pass. First learning set plus control took 25.87 minutes; idea pairs 114.08 seconds. Missing learners rarely completed observation/practice despite kind teachers; precise refusal/material causes remain unresolved. No rates or acceptance numbers were changed.

RES-13 fresh rerun not run: spread failure was already mathematically certain (max 26/40 < 32); other thresholds passed on the first 20. The attempted rerun was cancelled after starting; its eight completed partial results are excluded, not rejudged.

Spent inputs persist as full items for history links: ~22.5k spent items by day 45 (16.5k kernels). Scans must skip them; long games need compaction of spent items into history records (proposed for M4/M10 old-world storage).

Measured single gate seed after indexing: 26.10 s, 77.8 MiB, about 2.4 game years/minute; the requested tens-of-years/minute target remains unmet here. Native simulation suite: 122.3 MiB; repaired full app suite: 349.3 MiB. Phone frame deadlines, phone/cloud digests, sustained heat/battery, audible quality, unaided play answers and independent review remain unmeasured. Named fire-maintenance lookups still fail the name-free-choice principle Check and need review/repair. Winter health and full-scale worlds remain later scope. M3 is ready for review, not accepted complete.
